svg.title: Nine-step 4-Queens backtracking trace
svg.desc: Step 1: Place R0 C0. Board columns by row: [0, -1, -1, -1]. Place the first queen. Step 2: Place R1 C2. Board columns by row: [0, 2, -1, -1]. C0 and C1 conflict. C2 is safe. Step 3: No place in R2. Board columns by row: [0, 2, -1, -1]. Every square in R2 conflicts. Backtrack to R1. Step 4: Try R1 C3. Board columns by row: [0, 3, -1, -1]. Remove Q at R1 C2. Try the next column: C3. Step 5: Place R2 C1. Board columns by row: [0, 3, 1, -1]. C0 conflicts in R2. R3 has no safe square. Step 6: Backtrack to R0. Board columns by row: [1, -1, -1, -1]. From step 5: R2: C2, C3 conflict. R1: no columns left. Try R0 C1. Step 7: Place R1 C3. Board columns by row: [1, 3, -1, -1]. C0, C1, C2 conflict. C3 is safe. Step 8: Place R2 C0. Board columns by row: [1, 3, 0, -1]. C0 is safe in R2. Continue to R3. Step 9: Place R3 C2. Board columns by row: [1, 3, 0, 2]. C2 is safe in R3. First solution: [1, 3, 0, 2] Orange cells mark newly placed queens. A cross marks a rejected square. Empty cells are unfilled.
svg.text: No valid choices remain in R2 or R1.
